scripts.title: Money Giver
scripts.features: every 0.1 second (you can edit seconds) you get money (its 0.8 or 1.6 if you joined on TB1STEP (dev) group on roblox)
scripts.script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local clickEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ClickEvent")

-- false if u want stop
local running = true

task.spawn(function()
    while running do
        clickEvent:FireServer()
        task.wait(0.1) -- change this if you want
    end
end)
